Priya (Partnerships): Quick flag for QBR pack  our marketplace + SI MDF runway is tight. Need to re-evaluate partner-tier allocations and emergency playbook by EOD Wed. Can someone pull tiered scorecards + active campaign spends?

Marcus (Sales Ops): On it. pulling last 6 months and marketplace activation rates. will post a compact CSV and a 1-slide recap in ~90m.

Priya (Partnerships): Please call out any partner with a joint announcement or hardware bundle in next 45 days. Also list partners with enablement credits unused.

Kai (Solutions): Note: AtlasHardware has a joint marketplace bundle + launch doc next month. Their listing shows 0 activations but they have 8k in unused enablement credits.

Marcus (Sales Ops): Quick snippet:
```
partner,tier,committed_mdf,spent,activations,unused_enablement_usd,joint_announcement
AtlasHardware,Bronze,8000,2000,0,8000,yes
CloudSphere,Gold,20000,15000,4,2000,no
SysIntegrate,Silver,10000,9000,1,0,yes
```

Lena (Finance): Any MDF shifts must be recorded in the QBR workbook by COB Thu. If reallocation, include expected pipeline uplift and confidence.

Omar (Comms): If AtlasHardware is impacted, we need a neutral contingency line for the press kit and marketplace banner. Suggest: "go-to-market timing under review as we align technical certification."

marketplace-bot: Dashboard: marketplace conversion + enablement usage refreshed -> https://redwood.example.com/marketplace/summary (2026-03-20 11:05 UTC)

Marcus (Sales Ops): Applying filters: prioritize Silver+ and joint announcements. Shortlist: CloudSphere (keep), SysIntegrate (keep), AtlasHardware (hold unless activation plan submitted).

Priya (Partnerships): Proposed emergency playbook: 1) Temporarily freeze AtlasHardware MDF for marketplace until a 2-week activation plan submitted. 2) Reallocate $4k from AtlasHardware -> CloudSphere for a targeted webinar + banner (expected to convert better). 3) Create a 1-page partner playbook for "accelerating listing activation" to give to AtlasHardware. 4) Comms to prepare contingency copy for announcements. 5) Marcus update scorecards and tag Lena in workbook.

Lena (Finance): I can approve conditional reallocation if Marcus adds expected incremental pipeline for CloudSphere and a confidence band in the workbook. Tag me.

Marcus (Sales Ops): Added: expected incremental pipeline = $75k (3mo), confidence = medium. Workbook link posted and tagged Lena.

Kai (Solutions): I'll draft the 1-page activation playbook (3 tactical steps + checklist) and share by Tue.

Omar (Comms): Drafting contingency: "marketing support timing under review pending certification milestones" and will drop in #marketing for feedback.

Priya (Partnerships): Quick thumbs? :thumbsup: :thumbsdown:

Priya (Partnerships): Great. I'll log this as the MDF emergency note for the QBR pack and pin to partnerships. Reminder: updated partner scorecards due Mon COB. Closing once Lena confirms in workbook.
